study_strategy.warning: B. trifoliolata and B. swaseyi hybridize in Central Texas. Leaflet count alone can misidentify hybrids.

quick_split: B. trifoliolata — usually 3 stiff holly-like leaflets; dense rounded agarita habit.
B. swaseyi — usually 5–9 leaflets, reduced basal pair, duller reticulate foliage; more open Edwards Plateau shrub.
B. aquifolium — many pinnate holly-like leaflets + blue-purple berries; non-native Texas comparison.
comparison_lesson.caveat: Use leaflet architecture plus bracts/surface texture for suspected hybrids.
